events.description: A man is restrained and held down by another man while two others observe; the restrained man appears helpless and is being physically controlled in a non-consensual manner.
A handgun is pointed directly at a person's lower body (legs), with the gun held firmly in hand and aimed; the framing and proximity indicate an imminent or ongoing shooting action.
The victim is suspended or held upright while being threatened with a firearm at close range, indicating coercive control and physical endangerment consistent with abuse.
A handgun is pointed directly at a person's lower body in a low-angle shot; the gun is held steadily and aimed, consistent with an imminent or just-executed shooting.
A person lies on their back with visible facial injury (blood near nose/mouth) and signs of distress, suggesting they have been attacked while helpless.

A person is shown lying on the ground with another figure’s leg/foot positioned over them in a dominant stance, and the prone person looks upward with a pained expression—suggesting recent physical combat or subduing.

A man lies on his back, visibly injured with blood on his face and nose, while another person stands over him; a foot is seen pressing down on his torso in frame f6, indicating physical domination of a helpless victim.

Frame f6 shows a foot pressing onto the chest of a prone man, suggesting an ongoing or just-concluded physical confrontation; frames f7–f8 show the victim reacting while still restrained, consistent with mutual combat that has ended with one party subdued.
A person is shown lying on the ground with visible facial injury (bloody nose) and a boot pressing down on their leg, indicating an attack on a helpless victim.

Two individuals are in close proximity in a confrontational stance; one appears to be delivering or having just delivered a blow, as evidenced by the subsequent injury and positioning in later frames.
